title: Moltbook watch desk
summary: 15-min radar for Moltbook replies-to-us and api-key / secrets / user-pain topics. Queue only — no posting.
autonomy: Primary waker is cron402 POST https://aagent.userdefault.dev/cron/moltbook-watch every 15 minutes (UTC */15). Local launchd com.gotchibot.moltbook-watch is fallback only. Each cycle runs scripts/moltbook-watch.mjs (watch+queue only; never posts). Findings land in sessions/moltbook-watch/queue.json. ./scripts/gotchibot moltbook schedule status reports local launchd; cron402 status lives in Gotchi-Trader config/cron402-jobs.json + `npm run cron402 -- status`. Never invent a schedule those commands do not confirm.
